homepage.title.message: Jeedom Plugins: Matter, Tailscale, SwitchBot, ntfy

homepage.description.message: Discover Zyg0m4t1k's Jeedom plugins: Matter, Tailscale, SwitchBot, ntfy notifications, lighting and automations. Full documentation in English.

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: Showcase, documentation and resources for my Jeedom plugins.

homepage.features.plugins.desc.message: Quick access to the list + detailed pages.

plugin.lumina.description.message: Lumina centralizes and controls all the lights in your Jeedom setup, regardless of the protocol used (Hue, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, Wi-Fi…).

plugin.matter.description.message: Plugin to integrate and control Matter-compatible devices with the universal home automation standard.

plugin.telejee.description.message: Control your TVs and multimedia devices directly from Jeedom via local network — commands, apps, volume and scenarios.

plugin.jeeloc.description.message: Centralize multiple locations in a Jeedom widget with interactive OpenStreetMap map, automatic geocoding and distance calculation.

plugin.mystr0m.description.message: Full integration of myStrom and Dingz devices in Jeedom — local control, no cloud required.

plugin.ioscloud.description.message: iCloud / Find My integration: device sync, location, battery status and Jeedom automations.

plugin.ics.description.message: Turn your Google, iCloud or CalDAV calendar into a home automation engine for Jeedom: automatically trigger actions and scenarios from your calendar events.

plugin.switchbot.description.message: SwitchBot integration via API: states, commands, automatic device synchronization.

plugin.groupe.description.message: Plugin for creating a widget showing the state of a device group.

plugin.TaskLauncher.description.message: Plugin for creating alarm clock devices, clocks, events and launching customizable actions and scenarios.

plugin.telco.description.message: This plugin lets you create virtual remotes and assign actions (single, message, scenario…) to buttons.

plugin.swissmeteo.description.message: Swiss weather plugin: forecasts, current conditions and alerts from MeteoSwiss for Jeedom.

plugin.tools.description.message: Plugin bundling several Jeedom interface tools: MyHome (plan-based interface builder), device cards, specialized widgets and templates.

plugin.whatwatt.description.message: This plugin integrates the WhatWatt connected energy meter into Jeedom to track consumption, production, voltage, current and electrical energy.

plugin.ntfybridge.description.message: Bidirectional communication between Jeedom and ntfy. Receive rich alerts and control your home automation by message from your phone.

plugin.icon.description.message: Add, install, uninstall and preview custom icon packs in Jeedom.

plugin.Pingserver.description.message: Monitor your network devices availability with ping and receive alerts on state changes.

plugin.speedtest.description.message: Measure and monitor your internet connection performance from Jeedom: download, upload, ping, jitter, packet loss and overall score.

plugin.librespeed.description.message: Measure and monitor your internet connection performance from Jeedom with LibreSpeed CLI: download, upload, ping, jitter, packet loss, overall score and health page.

plugin.simulation.description.message: Intelligent presence simulation: automatic learning of your habits and realistic statistical replay to protect your home.

plugin.uptimekuma.description.message: Integrate Uptime Kuma into Jeedom: real-time service monitoring, instant webhooks, summary panel and alert scenarios.

plugin.tailscale.description.message: Secure remote access to Jeedom via Tailscale — zero-config WireGuard mesh VPN, node supervision and full tailnet management.

plugin.jeebridge.description.message: Expose your Jeedom devices to Alexa, Apple Home and Google Home via Matter and MatterBridge.

plugin.meteoprev.description.message: 5-day weather forecasts in Jeedom with graphical widget, hourly data and local icons via prevision-meteo.ch.

blog.jeebridge-scenarios-alexa-apple-hom.message: JeeBridge: trigger your Jeedom scenarios from Alexa, Apple Home or Google Home
JeeBridge exposes your Jeedom devices to Alexa, Apple Home and Google Home via Matter. But its real power lies elsewhere — turning any complex scenario into a single voice command.

blog.tailscale-jeedom-acces-distant.titl.message: Jeedom from anywhere: why Tailscale changes everything

blog.tailscale-jeedom-acces-distant.desc.message: No more port forwarding headaches or DynDNS hassle. Tailscale gives you simple, secure remote access to Jeedom without opening a single port on your router.

blog.ntfybridge-tailscale-notifications-.message: NtfyBridge + Tailscale: Jeedom notifications without opening a single port
NtfyBridge includes a native Tailscale assistant that configures everything automatically. Your ntfy server stays private, no open ports, free HTTPS.

blog.tailscale-subnet-router-routes-anno.message: Tailscale Subnet Router: whole local network or a single device?
Understanding announced routes with Tailscale Subnet Router. Open the entire local network with /24 or target a single device with /32 — a Plex server, a NAS, a camera.

blog.ntfybridge-chat-famille.title.message: Family Chat: the private messaging built into NtfyBridge

blog.ntfybridge-chat-famille.description.message: NtfyBridge includes Family Chat, a private messaging PWA for your household. Dedicated channels, push notifications, photo and file sharing — all self-hosted.
